reviews.title: Solid motherboard
reviews.comment:
Purchased because I couldn’t update the bios on an ECS motherboard to support 14th generation, and for the legacy PCI support. Have had good luck with Asus’ CSM boards in the past.
Note that the motherboard does not ship with bios support for 14th gen CPUs, I had to pull a 12th gen CPU out of another system to update the bios. Been running stable with an i3-14100F, 32GB Teamgroup DDR4 3200, and an Arc A750 on Win10Pro and Manjaro Mate Linux for a month now.
reviews.author: Mac

reviews.title: Gen 12 Motherboard 610 chip
reviews.comment: Upgraded a buddy's old tower with this motherboard decked out board with WiFi and NVMe system drive 16GB RAM, i3-12100 this is a killer upgrade from his old H55, i3-540 system. He said everything is great and he loves the speed.
reviews.author: tngsg1a

reviews.title: Doesn't seem to support some PCI cards.
reviews.comment: The machine doesn't seem to boot when there are any older (non GEN3) PCIe cards installed.  Asus support suggested this was expected.
reviews.author: SHANE
